_note: What Carla says in the Hardening shop (Shop/Dialogue). She says a greeting when the shop opens, a line when the player clicks a card or an upgrade, and a line after a purchase. Keep a line short (the box is narrow): about 90 letters at most. The upgrade lines say in everyday words what the upgrade is for.
greeting: Welcome! Have a look around, and spend your points wisely.
Hi! Pick what fits the problem you found, not what looks coolest.
Back again? Remember: the fix should match the problem.
bought_card: Good pick! Put it in your deck with EDIT DECK.
Done. Add it to your deck when you are ready.
bought_upgrade: Good choice! Now equip it under EDIT UPGRADES, or it will not help you.
Remember: an upgrade only works once it is equipped.

upgrades.unique: One key for every door is risky. Give each account its own password.
upgrades.twostep: A stolen password is not enough if the thief also needs your phone.
upgrades.lockout: After a few wrong tries, lock the account. Guessing gets them nowhere.
upgrades.alerts: A strange sign-in at 3 AM? This tells you at once, while there is still time.

cards.probe: A quick poke to see what is out there. Cheap, and it adds up.
cards.patch: Fix a weak spot before someone uses it. You even draw a card.
cards.audit: Check everything on the list. You will spot more and draw 3 cards.
cards.hunt: Go looking for the intruder instead of waiting. Hits hard, draws a card.
cards.encrypt: Scrambled data is useless to a thief. A good block, and a card.
cards.shutdown: Cut the attacker off completely. A big hit, and a little block.
